lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Review past narration by telling a short, ordered weekend story.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A relaxed fika conversation where a weekend story has a beginning, middle, and ending.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Understanding and producing a simple sequence of past events.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik use Monday fika to tell one short weekend story with a few concrete details and reactions.

main_focus.name: week 2 past-story review
main_focus.description: Combine preterite, a few irregular past forms, sequence words, and one feeling reaction.
model_examples: Till slut blev jag ganska trött.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use a balanced mix: 4-6 past-tense verbs, 2-3 sequence words, and 1-2 feeling reactions.

allowed_supporting_grammar: one simple reason clause if natural

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use familiar past-story words from the week rather than introducing a new theme.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker invites a weekend recap.
dialogue_shape.middle: A short story is told in three steps with a reaction.
dialogue_shape.ending: They close with a simple comment about starting the new week.

target_complexity.repetition: review past-tense storytelling patterns in an easy-to-follow order

focus: the first event in the weekend story
the next important event or change

sentence_focus: one sentence with an irregular past verb
one sentence starting with Till slut
one sentence giving a simple reaction
